name: Portals
description: Save URLs as named, searchable shortcuts
author: Core

walkthrough.title: Jump straight to the links you live in
walkthrough.summary: Save a URL as a named, searchable portal
walkthrough.body:
A portal turns a URL into something you can summon by name — a dashboard, a repo, a ticket board, a playlist. Portals can take a query too, so one portal becomes a search box for any site you use.

## To complete the task

1. Run **Open Portals**.
2. Add a link you open most days.
3. Summon it by name from the search bar.
